# Every shape a real list is written in, in one file: a repository whose
# directory name is derived from it, one that says what to call itself, one
# pinned to a ref, and one only some machines want.
#
# The placeholders are local bare repositories the test creates, because no test
# may reach the network (`guidance.md`, "Test environments"). A real list of
# this kind names repositories on the internet, and reads exactly the same.
{plugin}
{prompt} dest-name=p10k id=p10k  # the prompt

{plugin} ref=main dest-name=zsh-z

# The plugin that belongs on one machine and not the others, which is what a
# condition on an entry is for.
{plugin} dest-name=work-tools when="work"
